text:
ashley: quick sync: we need a concrete plan for immutable audit streams + exportable evidence for enterprise customers. Q3 target. main asks: verifiable manifests, BYOK/key-handshake, retention/legal-hold semantics.

 devon: ok. i'll sketch launch criteria. high-level gates: 1) immutable write path for audit events (append-only), 2) signed export manifests + detached sigs, 3) customer-managed key handshake + soft-escrow, 4) retention/hold control that overrides TTLs.

 ashley: add acceptance tests pls (automated). minimal smoke for each gate.

 devon: proposed smoke flow: create stream, append events, run export, verify manifest entries and signatures. sample commands:

 ```
 # create tenant stream and append
 redwoodctl streams create --tenant T42 --name audit-stream
 redwoodctl streams append --tenant T42 --stream audit-stream --file sample-events.ndjson

 # export + verify
 redwoodctl audit export --tenant T42 --stream audit-stream --from 2026-03-01 --to 2026-03-02 --out export.ndjson
 sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256
 redwoodctl audit verify-manifest --file export.manifest.ndjson --sig export.manifest.sig
 ```

 ravi: about keys: customers want rotation control. design option: soft-handshake where customer supplies wrapping key, we store wrapped DEKs, and escrow exists with strict multi-party approval + audit record. any emergency unwrap requires documented justification.

 marta: for SOC2/ISO mapping: every launch gate must map to a control id. also need region-specific retention matrix (EU, US, APAC) and proof-of-retention artifact daily for auditors.

 sophia: legal note: escrow access policy must include timeboxed access, requestor identity, business justification, and automated notification to customer security contacts. include court-order handling steps.

 ashley: ops-runbook reqs: immutable receipts bucket, per-escrow action log, and rollback/noop behavior for non-authorized attempts.

 ops-bot: CI job triggered: ci/audit-evidence-tests -> staging. status: started. :rocket:

 devon: staging tests passing except for edge case where large exports hang at 95%. i'll open a PR for a retry wrapper.

 ravi: product question: should export concurrency be per-tenant or global? customers asked for burst windows during legal discovery.

 ashley: propose tiered concurrency caps per plan: starter=1, standard=3, enterprise=10, with short burst allowance and backoff headers. include admin override for emergency.

 marta: auditors will want signed manifests daily. format suggestion: newline-delimited JSON (manifest items) + detached signature. that aligns with streaming.

 devon: agreed. i'll draft a manifest schema: fields: event_count, from_ts, to_ts, sha256, stream_id, sequence_range, signature_meta. will push to spec repo.

 sophia: also request a short customer contract blurb for legal-hold and key responsibilities. sample wording: "Customer retains responsibility for KEK rotation; Redwood provides escrow under defined emergency procedures."

 ashley: action list: @devon spec + smoke tests + manifest schema; @ravi key-handshake + escrow audit design; @marta SOC2/ISO control mapping + regional retention matrix; @sophia legal-hold/contract language. review Fri 10am.

 devon: aiming for draft PR Thu afternoon.

 ravi: i'll prepare diagrams for soft-handshake and emergency workflow.

 marta: i'll extract control references from last SOC2 report and annotate gaps.

 sophia: will draft contract clause and sample customer notice.

 ashley: thanks. goal = enable pilot customers in Q3 and have Ops-ready runbook. flag blockers asap. :thumbsup:
